scope: Only 3C-R1 reference acquisition, measurement and evidence-use contracts; no generator changes or R2-R9 implementation
question: Can a complete pinned source model be ingested and measured reproducibly without confusing calibration, numerical verification and scientific acceptance?

protocol.source_epoch: PB2002 present-day representation published in 2003; not 2026 observations
protocol.source_coordinates: published longitude east/latitude north degrees on a sphere

splits.outline_development: all except reserved plates; Cocos explicitly previously exposed
splits.motion_withheld: entire boundary segments touching any reserved plate, not random steps
splits.orogen_shapes: all reserved from generation tuning; used for source/numerical verification
splits.independence: within-PB2002 spatial/observable holdout, NOT a second independent dataset

numerical_checks.area: Gauss-Bonnet versus independent solid-angle fan: max(2e-12,64*N*eps) sr
numerical_checks.source_position: DIG six significant digits: <=60m numerical rounding, not geological accuracy
numerical_checks.motion: per-step component bound from 0.001-degree endpoints, 0.001-degree poles, 0.0001 deg/Ma rates and 0.1 mm/a outputs
numerical_checks.topology: exact canonical decimal-coordinate edge incidence; report discrepancies, never snap
numerical_checks.resolution: uniform arc-length sampling at named physical scales, both phases; short outlines marked unresolved

scientific_checks.shape_population: joint area, compactness, reflex turning, boundary-moment measures and adjacency; no acceptance threshold invented
scientific_checks.boundary_structure: class-specific lengths and transitions, small-plate margin associations; source classifications retained
scientific_checks.kinematics: relative Euler motion and signs; this is not independent validation of a dynamic velocity field
scientific_checks.deformation: orogens are overlays and not added to rigid-plate area
scientific_checks.history: not supplied by this static model; cannot pass persistence/formation/reorganisation tests
scientific_checks.independent_model: not supplied by a PB2002 reformat; required at R9
scientific_checks.actual_geological_uncertainty: not globally quantified by source; do not turn rounding bounds into confidence intervals

outstanding_reference_challenges.name: multi-epoch plate reconstruction
outstanding_reference_challenges.reason: required for history; present-day poles cannot invent past topology

outstanding_reference_challenges.name: external plate/deformation model with explicit ancestry
outstanding_reference_challenges.reason: cross-model challenge; shared observations must be disclosed

sources.author: Peter Bird
warnings: single present-day model, not a time series
orogens are overlapping deformation overlays, not extra plates
coordinate precision is not geological accuracy
derived GIS copies are not independent evidence

test_layers.unit: synthetic geometry, strict parsers, already-exposed Cocos and AF-AN records; does not require or impersonate full PB2002
test_layers.full_reference: load every pinned file, require complete counts, check area/motion/connectivity and record all source discrepancies
test_layers.scientific_generation: not assessed by R1; remains R5-R9

execution.history_dataset: not supplied by static PB2002; required before history-validation claims
